meta.time_axis_note: Kova advances in discrete iterations with no defined wall-clock duration. Speeds are per-iteration distances divided by a NOMINAL timestep chosen so the median walking speed is about 1.2 m/s. They are plausible, not measured. Replace NOMINAL_SECONDS_PER_ITERATION with a calibrated figure if the model's timestep is ever established.
meta.heading_unit: degrees clockwise from north (derived from consecutive points)
meta.transform: local affine, fitted to simulation_results_heat_wgs84.csv (0.48 cm mean error)
